tools.name: handoff_put
tools.description: Store a piece of context and get back a short code. The person gives the link handover.tools/<code> to an agent on another device and it can fetch the content — no copy-paste of long text. The code is 8 letters, easy to type on a phone. NOT ENCRYPTED: the server can read what you store, so never put

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: channel_send, channel_fetch, channel_close · Private data: handoff_put, channel_open, channel_join · Public sink: channel_open, channel_join, channel_send · Destructive: handoff_put, handoff_revoke, channel_join.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: channel_send, channel_fetch, channel_close · Private data: handoff_put, channel_open, channel_join · Public sink: channel_open, channel_join, channel_send · Destructive: handoff_put, handoff_revoke, channel_join

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
